# Pull request

## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes.

## Why

Explain the user problem, bug, or documentation gap being addressed.

## Validation

- [ ] I tested the change where applicable.
- [ ] I updated documentation where needed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where applicable.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, credentials, or private data.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and consistent with the repository's scope.

## Notes

Add limitations, compatibility considerations, or follow-up work.
